summary: Two-axis pad for temperature and top-p on a glowing pixel field; on release the puck springs onto the nearest 0.05 step.

events.name: input
events.description: Fires continuously while dragging. Values are 0 to 1, rounded to two decimals; `x` is temperature, `y` is top-p.

events.name: change
events.description: Fires when the puck settles: on pointer release (snapped to 0.05), on arrow keys and on double-click reset.

methods.description: Springs the puck to the given position (each axis limited to 0 to 1) and fires `change`. Values that are not finite numbers are ignored.

keyboard.action: Move temperature down or up by 0.05.
Move top-p down or up by 0.05.

accessibility: The pad is focusable (`tabindex="0"`) with `role="group"` and `aria-label="Sampling pad: temperature and top-p. Arrow keys move, double-click resets."`.
Current values are shown as text below the pad. After each arrow key a visually hidden `aria-live="polite"` region announces both values, for example "Temperature 0.75, top-p 0.90".
motion: With reduced motion, the puck jumps to its target instead of springing and the dots around it do not orbit; the trail and ripples still draw.
notes: Both axes run from 0 to 1. The starting position, and the double-click reset, is temperature 0.7 and top-p 0.9.
There is no attribute for the initial value; call `settle(x, y)` to set it from script.
